pages.name: Herald of Cold
pages.text: Third in the cycle. Brings a local winter.

pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Within $(thing)50 blocks$() it is winter: snowy weather, snow on suitable surfaces, frozen water. Blows slow you and chill you as in powder snow. The closer to the Herald, the colder, and Spirit Form offers no shelter.

pages.title: How to defeat it
pages.text: $(li)$(#2E7D4F)Spirit Immunity$() cleanses negative effects.$(li)$(#2E7D4F)Spirit Touch$() lets you hurl blocks.$(li)$(#2E7D4F)Scales$() and other ranged weapons strike from afar.

pages.title: Reward
pages.text: Victory leaves a $(item)Heart of Cold$(), embodying the Path of Darkness.
